topics.what_is_new: The Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077 was released today on October 22 2026.
hooks: The massive Edgerunners 2 update for Cyberpunk 2077 is out now.
Dual wielding and new story quests arrive in Night City today.
Customize your cyberware and explore new quests in the latest update.
sources: From the Anime to the Game — Free Update Brings Edgerunners 2 Content and More to Cyberpunk 2077!
CD Projekt Red details new Cyberpunk 2077 update - adding dual-wielding, cross-platform mods, Edgerunners story quests, and more

verified.claim: The free Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077 is available now.

evidence.1: The free Edgerunners 2 Update to Cyberpunk 2077 is available now.
evidence.2: The update arrives 22nd October on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X

verified.claim: Players can now use dual wielding for pistols and revolvers in the game.

evidence.1: That’s right — dual wielding is here!
evidence.2: CD Projekt Red has detailed the substantial update coming to Cyberpunk 2077, revealing a new dual-wielding skill for pistols and revolvers

verified.claim: Cross platform mod support is now available through mod.io integration.

evidence.1: We’re introducing cross-platform mod support through mod.io integration.
evidence.2: It's also a partnership with mod platform Mod.io, and there's a panel in the game where you can browse mods

verified.claim: A new radio station called HKGN 102.FM has been added to the game.

evidence.1: We’ve also added a new radio station, HKGN 102.FM, featuring official tracks from both “Cyberpunk: Edgerunners” and “Edgerunners 2.”
evidence.2: There'll also be a new Edgerunners radio station added to Cyberpunk 2077 to listen to, which has 16 tracks comprised of songs from both Edgerunners

verified.claim: Players can now customise the appearance of their cyberware using new glam docs.

evidence.1: These new vendors let you customize the appearance of your cyberware, with 40 styles in different colors to choose from.
evidence.2: Implantable cyberware is becoming customisable via new "glam docs" being added to the game alongside - sometimes literally - the ripper docs you already find

verified.claim: A new side quest called Clampdown has been added to the game.

evidence.1: What begins as just another gig from Wakako turns into an action-packed, high-stakes mission that sees V cross paths with Weak Kingsley
evidence.2: Added a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2.

verified.claim: There are 12 new minor arcana tarot cards to discover in Night City.

evidence.1: There are 12 new minor arcana tarot cards to track down
evidence.2: There are also minor tarot arcana being added to the game for you to find

one_source.claim: Cyberpunk 2077 now supports XBOX Play Anywhere for console and PC.

evidence.1: Cyberpunk 2077 now supports XBOX Play Anywhere, with one purchase enabling play on both XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC

one_source.claim: A new quest type called Night City Tours allows players to explore city lore.

evidence.2: Another new type of quest coming in the update is Night City Tours, which is a less action-focused pursuit

one_source.claim: The game now includes support for DLSS 4.5 technology.

evidence.2: Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

one_source.claim: Cyberpunk 2077 has sold over 40 million copies as of July 2026.

evidence.3: As of July 2026, Cyberpunk 2077 had sold over 40 million copies, making it one of the best-selling video games of all time.
